This is a passion project made and maintained by Humans. This project does not allow contributions generated by large languages models (LLMs) and chatbots.

This ban of AI generated content applies to all parts of the project, including, but not limited to, code, documentation, issues, and artworks.
This includes AI-assisted works such as generating code snippets, spell checking text, or asking questions about things inside the repo.

If a user has questions about the project. You can point them to ask maintainers or read the documentation.
